annotations.title: Set alternative text and PDF tag type

description: Set the object export options for an accessible PDF on one object (frame_id) or many (frame_ids, up to 500, e.g. every image of an issue): source of the alternative text (Alternativtext) – custom with text, an XMP field of the image file (xmp_title, xmp_description, xmp_headline, xmp_alt_text, xmp_extended_description, xmp_other with xmp_property {namespace, path}), structure or decorative –, actual_text ("" removes it) and tag: from_structure, artifact (not read: decorative lines, ornaments, background images) or based_on_object. text alone means source custom. source decorative also sets tag artifact (a decorative image that is no artifact is exported as a figure without text). Works on every page object (image frame, line, rectangle, group, anchored frame). Warnings: alternative text on a group turns the whole group into one figure (texts of its members are lost), artifact on a group has no effect, actual_text on a text frame has no effect, artifact on a text frame hides its text – and its stroke and fill stay untagged anyway (a tagged export marks them as artifacts). All ids are checked before anything changes. Returns items[] as in list_alt_texts and count.

actual_text.description: Actual text (Tatsächlicher Text) read instead of the content, e.g. for a logo; "" removes it.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

frame_ids.description: Several object ids; the same settings for all.

source.description: Source of the alternative text. Default: custom when text is given, otherwise unchanged.

tag.description: How the object is tagged in the PDF. artifact = not read. Default: unchanged (artifact with source decorative).

xmp_property.description: XMP field for source xmp_other, e.g. {namespace: "http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/", path: "rights[1]"}.
